attribute.name: IncludeFilter
attribute.description: A regular expression denoting the names of the resources to which this configuration applies.

attribute.name: ExcludeFilter
attribute.description: A regular expression denoting the names of the resources to which this configuration does not apply.

attribute.name: Name
attribute.description: The name of the rule. If left empty, the rule UID is used.

relationship.name: Parameters
relationship.description: The strategy of publishing, specifying the publisher and its parameters.

relationship.name: LinkedBundles
relationship.description: Rule bundles that are part of this bundle. This enables modular construction of the rule bundles from, for example, the rule bundles of the libraries.

relationship.name: Rules
relationship.description: Rules that are part of this set.

attribute.name: FileName
attribute.description: The name of the ROOT file used to save the exported data.

attribute.name: ISServer
attribute.description: Denotes the IS server to which the resource is published.

attribute.name: OHServer
attribute.description: Denotes the OH server to which the resource is published.

attribute.name: ROOTProvider
attribute.description: Denotes the ROOT Provider used to export the histograms.

attribute.name: PublishInterval
attribute.description: The interval between two succesive publications. If 0, the object is not published.

attribute.name: NumberOfSlots
attribute.description: The publication interval will be split in the provided number of slots. Object publication will deterministically happen at the slot boundaries.

attribute.name: OutputStream
attribute.description: A integer with value 0 for cout, and 1 for cerr.

relationship.name: ConfigurationRules
relationship.description: Rules controlling the publishing of the monitored resources of this application.
